title: Support for Multiple Named Custom Themes
body:
### Problem

Currently, Streamlit allows us to define only **one** custom theme in the .streamlit/config.toml file. While this is a great feature, it feels limiting. Much like developers/users who enjoy switching between light and dark modes in their IDEs/browsers, I often want to change the look and feel of my app based on different contexts, events, or even personal mood. 

### Solution

```toml
# .streamlit/config.toml

[theme]
base = "corporate-light" # Default active theme key

# Define the "Corporate Light" theme
[theme.corporate-light]
name = "Corporate Light" # A friendly name, cannot use default theme 'dark' or 'light'
primaryColor = "#1e3a8a"
backgroundColor = "#ffffff"
secondaryBackgroundColor = "#f0f0f0"
textColor = "#31333F"
font = "sans serif"

# Define a "Midnight Dark" theme
[theme.midnight-dark]
name = "Midnight Dark"
primaryColor = "#bfdbfe"
backgroundColor = "#1e293b"
secondaryBackgroundColor = "#334155"
textColor = "#f1f5f9"
font = "sans serif"
```
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here. For example, did this FR come from <https://discuss.streamlit.io> or another site? Link the original source here!
